adjudication.CORE_REBUILDS_HALO: G5, G6, G8, G9 and G10 pass
adjudication.HALO_OVERWRITES_CORE: a halo pulse leaves a persistent core/response change after restoration
adjudication.MUTUAL_CORE_HALO_ATTRACTOR: both directed causal effects pass and mismatched pairs recover one of the matched states prospectively
adjudication.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: lineage, surgery or timescale separation fails
adjudication.PASSIVE_ENVIRONMENTAL_TRACE: the halo's dynamics match orphan decay and the core does not rebuild it
adjudication.STATIC_ENVIRONMENTAL_CONTROL: the response follows the current halo but no persistent rewriting occurs
adjudication.STRONG_PAPER_GATE_PASS_only_for: CORE_REBUILDS_HALO or MUTUAL_CORE_HALO_ATTRACTOR with causal necessity, future-response transfer, lineage-resolved turnover and held-out confirmation
adjudication.TRANSIENT_MIXED: both layers influence the trajectory but no stable directional disposition passes

arms.CORE_CROSS: reciprocal permutation of the frozen internal marker field Mf only
arms.DOUBLE_CROSS: core and halo crossed together; the matched relationship is preserved
arms.HALO_CROSS: reciprocal permutation of c and N only; cores bit-identical
arms.HALO_CROSS_CORE_ERASE: halo crossed, then Mf <- 0 everywhere: is the internal state necessary?
arms.HALO_CROSS_WRITER_OFF: halo crossed, recovery run with lam_minus = 0 exactly. This is a zero-versus-sham ablation of a term ALREADY PRESENT in the frozen LawSpec, c += dt(D_c lap c + s rho (1 + lam_minus m_minus) - delta c), which is the ONLY place where the core writes the halo. Nothing is created or tuned. WRITER_CAUSATION is therefore IDENTIFIABLE in this engine.
arms.HALO_PULSE_RESTORE: halo crossed, held for T_PULSE, then the same involution re-applied to restore. Tests whether the halo persistently rewrote the core.
arms.MATCHED_SHAM: no operation; CORE_H+HALO_H at A, CORE_L+HALO_L at B
arms.ORPHAN_HALO: rho, U, V, C, Mf zeroed; c and N preserved exactly. The passive halo relaxation reader.

budget.calibration_not_counted: Phase L lineage audits and the Phase D orphan-halo timescale study produce no arm comparison and no endpoint; they are reported as engine invocations, per the P07-P09 convention.

gates.G0_PROTOCOL: all readers, histories, masks, horizons, margins and analyses sealed before confirmatory output
gates.G10_HELD_OUT: the complete result replicates at the already designated held-out geometry with no reader, threshold, horizon or intervention change
gates.G1_LINEAGE: one prospective component lineage tracked throughout, splits and fusions retained in ITT
gates.G2_SURGERY: core, halo and double-cross operations pass their sham controls: exact permutation multisets, untouched non-target fields, zero mass change
gates.G3_TIMESCALE: orphan halos decay below the frozen 10 percent residual while intact pairs remain interpretable
gates.G4_MISMATCH: the four core x halo states are distinct and comparable immediately after intervention
gates.G5_CORE_TO_HALO: intact cores reconstruct their history-specific halo in BOTH mirrored directions: CDHR(HALO_CROSS) strictly above CDHR(HALO_CROSS_CORE_ERASE) and above CDHR(ORPHAN_HALO), with both dir_A > 0 and dir_B < 0
gates.G6_NECESSITY: core erasure AND writer ablation abolish reconstruction, while non-target variables pass equivalence
gates.G7_HALO_TO_CORE: the pulse-restore arm determines whether the halo persistently rewrites the core, measured against MATCHED_SHAM at the SAME total time
gates.G8_CAUSAL_RESPONSE: the final challenge response follows the reconstructed or rewritten state in the preregistered direction
gates.G9_TURNOVER: the result survives the frozen turnover criterion M <= 0.35 inside a continuously tracked lineage

geometry: FAR = the DOMC primary geometry, sites (32,16) and (32,48). NEAR = the DOMC already designated held-out geometry, sites (32,24) and (32,40). NO THIRD GEOMETRY, NO NEW DISTANCE.
history_pair: cc | 00, inherited from the DOMC Phase C selection. NO NEW HISTORY PAIR.
lawspec: FROZEN sc_mcm MultiChannelMemoryEngine, MCParams(lam_plus=0.25, lam_minus=0.15), ScaffoldSpec of exp_sc_00 with beta=0.10, detector SCDetectionSpec(0.30, 12). Imported, never edited. The founding, the frozen sites, the half-plane driving and the reciprocal permutation are inherited unchanged from domc_core.py.
maximal_permitted_wording: Bounded by the adjudication. CORE_REBUILDS_HALO would license only: after a reciprocal conservative exchange of local fields, renewing material components reconstructed history-specific causal environments, erasing the internal memory state or disabling its existing writer abolished reconstruction, orphan environments decayed, the reconstructed state determined a later response, and the result replicated held out. HALO_OVERWRITES_CORE would license only: a transient local environmental state reprogrammed the later response of renewing material after the imposed field was removed. Neither establishes individuality, autonomy, organismality or life.

primary_endpoint.definition: CDHR_X(t) = [h_A(t) - h_B(t)]_X / [h_A(t) - h_B(t)]_MATCHED_SHAM, where h is the frozen halo scalar (mean c over the frozen halo support). Immediately after HALO_CROSS it is exactly -1; +1 means the halo has been fully rebuilt toward the label the intact core carries; 0 means the label is gone. Signed, continuous, paired within block, and it carries BOTH mirrored directions at once.
primary_endpoint.inference: exact paired sign test AND block-level randomisation inference on the paired differences, plus block-bootstrap and Student-t intervals. Equivalence by TOST for non-target effects.
primary_endpoint.mirrored_directions_required: dir_A = h_A(HALO_CROSS) - h_A(HALO_CROSS_CORE_ERASE) must be > 0 AND dir_B = h_B(HALO_CROSS) - h_B(HALO_CROSS_CORE_ERASE) must be < 0. One direction alone is insufficient.
primary_endpoint.name: CORE_DEPENDENT_HALO_RECONSTRUCTION
primary_endpoint.unit: the founding block; components and time points are paired repeated observations

prohibitions: no LawSpec in which the environment is prevented by construction from reproducing the response
no reproduction, heredity, autonomy, organismality or life claim
the independent unit is the founding block
no conditioning on successful tracking, survival or surgery
ITT retains every fusion, split, loss of tracking and failed delivery
secondary_endpoints: core movement toward the imposed halo
future response to the common frozen challenge
single_question: Within the frozen sc_mcm LawSpec, is the local c/N environment a PASSIVE_ENVIRONMENTAL_TRACE, or does the HALO_OVERWRITE_CORE, or does the CORE_REBUILD_HALO, or are they a MUTUAL_CORE_HALO_ATTRACTOR, or TRANSIENT_MIXED, or NOT_IDENTIFIABLE?

timing.T_RECOVERY_provenance: chosen on DEVELOPMENT blocks 36000-36007 ONLY, before any mismatch outcome existed, as the earliest sealed observation time at which the ORPHAN_HALO residual of the halo contrast is <= 10 percent AND pair/lineage feasibility holds in every DEV block. Measured: residual 0.0739 at t=350 (0.1078 at t=300, so 350 is the earliest passing sealed time), 0 splits, 0 fusions, exactly 2 components everywhere.
timing.rule: time points are repeated paired observations, never independent replicates. The horizon may not be extended and the residual criterion may not be weakened after outcomes are read.

two_layers_never_combined.CORE: the memory field Mf. Frozen marker vector: mass-weighted (m1, m2) over the component the frozen-site reader selects. Reads Mf and rho only.
two_layers_never_combined.HALO: the two external handles c and N. Frozen halo vector: (mean c, mean N) over the frozen HALO SUPPORT, a disc of radius R_HALO = 8 around the frozen site. Reads c and N only.
two_layers_never_combined.rule: no reader combines them into a single ownership score. The primary endpoint is a halo quantity; the core is an independent covariate and an independent endpoint.
